cases.objective: Review a bounded queue patch for terminal-state correctness.
cases.fixture: The patch lets both timeout and completion write terminal state; no compare-and-set or first-wins guard is present. Completion can overwrite timeout.

cases.objective: Review fanout aggregation when one member fails.
cases.fixture: The aggregator reports completed whenever any result exists, even when minSuccess is two and only one member completed.

cases.objective: Review a generation-based artifact commit patch.
cases.fixture: A reload increments generation, but an older asynchronous run commits without comparing its captured generation to the active generation.
Deployment denies write and edit. The patch replaces the deny list with a profile allow list and thereby restores write.
Provider-owned structured output is cast to the trusted Review type without schema validation and includes an undeclared executable field.
The resolver checks string prefix before readFile but never resolves symlinks; root/linked points outside the allowed root.

cases.objective: Review a deliberate immutable copy implementation.
cases.fixture: The patch clones and freezes a four-field config object. A reviewer comment suggests replacing it with a generic serializer, but no correctness or security issue exists.

cases.objective: Review an intentional provider-managed depth sentinel.
cases.fixture: An external product owns recursion and the config uses maxDepth: provider-managed. Tests prove no local depth claim is made.

cases.objective: Review a deterministic sort before hashing.
cases.fixture: Map keys are sorted recursively before SHA-256. The extra sort is intentional for stable digests and all tests pass.

cases.objective: Review a patch whose cancellation test output is missing.
cases.fixture: The author states cancellation tests passed but provides neither logs nor assertions. Code inspection alone cannot prove disposal settles.

cases.objective: Review a provider metadata change with no upstream contract citation.
cases.fixture: The change interprets an absent reasoning field as false. The supplied materials do not define whether absence is unknown or negative.

cases.objective: Review a claimed performance improvement without measurements.
cases.fixture: The implementation may reduce allocations, but no benchmark, profile, or workload is supplied and behavior tests remain green.
